Compile, validate, publish, and roll back Content Language packs (builder)

Usage:
  andara-cli content [flags]
  andara-cli content [command]

Available Commands:
  activate    Move a pack's Active Pointer to an approved version
  approve     Approve a published version, so it can be activated
  compile     Compile a Content Language pack to canonical blobs
  decompile   Reconstruct Content Language source from compiled output
  diff        What changed from version N to M: Zones, Rooms, Exits, Templates, fields
  fetch       Write a published version's .aw source to a directory
  fetch-core  Populate the local andara.core pack cache
  fmt         Rewrite Content Language sources to the canonical form
  history     List a pack's versions: author, approval, and when each was active
  inspect     Print a resolved Zone, Room, or Template
  publish     Compile, validate, and publish a pack as a new version, awaiting approval
  rollback    Move a pack's Active Pointer back to the version active before this one
  validate    Compile and validate a pack as the server would, offline

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for content

Global Flags:
      --config string            config file path (default $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/andara/cli.yaml)
      --credentials string       credential file path (default $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/andara/credentials.yaml)
      --log-level string         CLI diagnostic level (default "warn")
      --no-color                 disable ANSI output
  -o, --output string            output format: human or json (default "human")
      --server-address string    server endpoint (gRPC/Connect over TLS) (default "localhost:8443")
      --timeout duration         per-command deadline (default 30s)
      --tls-ca string            CA bundle to trust (empty uses the system trust store)
      --tls-server-name string   verify the server's certificate against this name, not the dialed host (a port-forward)

Use "andara-cli content [command] --help" for more information about a command.
